notes: Canonical source migration was validated on helper run 37199558877 from exact base a8246230d9e2fa0f9a09b92297dc308e03fcf4e4. SummonScout.lua publishes W112_SUMMONSCOUT_API_V1/EventAPI and W112_SUMMONSCOUT_STATE/SS directly before installing OnEvent.
